verdict.rationale: Airbyte documents AI-native support: PyAirbyte loads data into caches for Python/AI developers, MCP servers connect agents (Claude, Cursor, etc.) to synced data, and marketing copy says agents can 'query, search, and act on your data in real-time.' Community threads confirm a Pinecone vector-store destination exists, but also show real limitations—users complain FOSS/self-hosted vector stores like pgvector aren't supported, only proprietary Pinecone, indicating the LLM-ready/vector-store path is narrow rather than comprehensive. Missing for 10: broader vector-store destination coverage (pgvector, Weaviate, etc.), embedding/chunking pipeline details, and independent hands-on validation that synced data is retrieval-ready for agents beyond marketing claims.
